narrativeBlocks.title: Change is the engine
narrativeBlocks.body: Ovid’s Metamorphoses links myths through transformation: bodies, desires, landscapes, and identities continually change.

narrativeBlocks.title: Roman reception
narrativeBlocks.body: Ovid is Roman literature shaped by Greek myth and Roman concerns. Treat him as a major source, not as neutral Greek evidence.

narrativeBlocks.title: What the second source adds
narrativeBlocks.body: The additional corpus record gives a second lens on the same tradition. Compare it with the first source instead of treating either as a complete canon.

narrativeBlocks.title: How to read this evidence
narrativeBlocks.body: Ask what kind of source this is, who translated or organized it, what it can actually prove, and whether another text preserves a different version.

narrativeBlocks.title: A different canon
narrativeBlocks.body: Roman myth asks how inherited stories are reworked into a new literary and political world.
